source.section: Schedule SB (PDF page 1) and its Instructions: line 17 and the Retirement Income Subtraction Worksheet lines 1-6 (SB Instructions PDF page 8; Publication 126 PDF pages 8-9 section 4.E(2)); Form 1 lines 1-12 (Form 1 PDF page 1); Form 1 Instructions PDF page 15 line 8 and lines 10a-10b (PDF pages 15-16), PDF pages 35-37 2025 Standard Deduction Table (row named in worked), PDF page 15 line 12 with the PDF pages 38-43 Tax Table and PDF page 44 Tax Computation Worksheet; tax figured from the 2025 Tax Rate Schedules, Publication 106 PDF pages 6-7

worked: Single, 66: IRA 6,000, interest 9,000; federal AGI exactly 15,000 is not less than 15,000, so no line 17 subtraction. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = ira distribution (you) 6,000.00 + interest 9,000.00 = 15,000.00. Federal taxable income = 15,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 + 1 x 2,000.00 = 0.00 (floored at 0); the federal senior deduction is ignored. Form 1 line 1 federal AGI 15,000.00; line 2 Schedule I adjustments 0.00; line 3 15,000.00; line 4 additions 0.00; line 5 15,000.00. Schedule SB: no subtraction applies; line 50 0.00. Schedule SB line 17: federal AGI 15,000.00 is not less than 15,000.00, so no 5,000 subtraction. Form 1 line 6 0.00; line 7 Wisconsin income = 15,000.00 - 0.00 = 15,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction, 2025 Standard Deduction Table (Form 1 Instructions PDF page 35), row 15,000 to less than 15,500, column Single: 13,560.00 (printed row, at least / less than / single / joint / separate / head of household: 15,000 / 15,500 / 13,560 / 25,110 / 11,562 / 17,520). Line 9 = 15,000.00 - 13,560.00 = 1,440.00. Line 10a 1 x 700 = 700.00; line 10b 1 x 250 = 250.00; line 10c 950.00. Line 11 taxable income = 1,440.00 - 950.00 = 490.00. Line 12 tax, Schedule A (single) as numbers: 3.5% x 490.00 = 17.15; total 17.15, rounded once to 17.15. The Tax Table row 400 to 500 (PDF page 38) gives 16; expected keeps the schedule. Credits (lines 13-20, 30-35): none modelled; 0.00. State income tax 17.15.
